notes.title: Ho-Ho-Holiday Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899580/c6ccb582b2415000634a1e4cd916a41b48f42a18.png[/img]

🎄 Hello Holiday Update!

Ho-ho-hello, Pizza Kidd fans! 🎅🍕 It’s that time of year again—where we don't just deck the halls while devouring mom's cookies, we deck monsters while devouring pizza!

Since Pizza Kidd's Steam Scream October release, we’ve been working harder than Santa’s elves on double espresso shots to bring you some much needed festive fixes and fiery fast updates. So, grab a hot cocoa (or a slice of hot pizza), and check out what’s cooking in the Kidd Games' oven!

[b]Here’s what’s new in Pizza Kidd[/b]

🔧 Latest Updates:

• Temp Run/Dash + Heavy Punch Attack Added (more tweaks / animation coming)
• Super Moves Update: Super moves are now unblockable by Baku & Haku enemies
• Enemy Adjustments: Lumaca & Siput’s "push boxes" are deactivated when attacking for smoother gameplay.
• Fullscreen Options Improved: Now includes Fullscreen Borderless Window mode for more display flexibility.

🪳 Bug Fixes:

• Block/Guard retreat (hop-step) while facing Left is now fixed.
• Right SHIFT button (for block/guard) on the keyboard is now functional.

🌟 Help Us Grow!

We’re so grateful for the support of our amazing community. Here’s how you can keep helping us make Pizza Kidd even better:

Share the game with your friends and encourage them to wishlist it on Steam!

Follow us on Twitter and Discord for sneak peeks, updates, and behind-the-scenes content.

[b]Kickstarter Campaign Coming Soon[/b]

Be on the lookout for our upcoming Kickstarter campaign and help make the next stage of Pizza Kidd a reality!

We’re super psyched about what’s to come in 2025 and can’t wait to share more updates with you. Have a fantastic holiday season, and thank you for being part of the Pizza Kidd journey!

(and remember to "be good for goodness sake! See you in 2025! 🎄👾)

🎮✨ – The Kidd Games Team
